contract_gaps.compatibility_pagination: The 21 compatibility operations retain their caller-owned cursor and limit arguments and therefore remain explicit-page contracts. New leaf collections use automatic bounded cursor traversal.
contract_gaps.environment_origin: The official document records separate production and sandbox origins. This pack pins the production origin and uses endpoint-host connection matching; it does not claim sandbox execution or weaken matching to the Square vendor tag.
contract_gaps.freeform_maps: Sixteen bulk operations carry provider-keyed request maps. They use bounded body_raw contracts so arbitrary map keys remain available without opening undeclared top-level wire arguments.
contract_gaps.raw_optional_idempotency: Seven raw-body POST mutations document an optional idempotency_key that cannot be presence-checked inside body_raw. They remain conservatively non-idempotent, and bundled raw-body workflows instruct the caller to include a unique key.
contract_gaps.catalog_range_query: The compatibility catalog.filter operation keeps its six existing top-level arguments but omits query.range_query from the validated query object because that variant carries nested int64 values the structured body binding cannot serialize losslessly.
contract_gaps.empty_body_pagination: Required all-optional search bodies begin as an explicit empty JSON body. The gateway drops only that synthesized empty raw marker when structured page fields are added, so SearchVendors and limit-bearing body searches can walk without page-one replay.
contract_gaps.multipart: Four official operations require multipart file parts; the bounded REST binding supports JSON but has no multipart encoder, so the routes remain excluded rather than being misbound.
contract_gaps.scopes: Some official operations declare oauth2 with an empty scope array, while BANK_ACCOUNTS_WRITE and PAYMENT_METHODS_READ appear on operations but not in the document scope dictionary. Description-stated PAYOUTS_READ is retained for the three compatibility payout reads; all other omissions are left unlabeled rather than invented, and every such operation keeps its risk-tier approval contract.
